name: JsonSax
description: Streaming JSON SAX parser (StreamingJsonParser), the FreeInk SDK's API over this fork's Rust reader (rust/crates/bembeyaz-json): decodes escapes (\uXXXX to UTF-8), bounded token buffer, no DOM.
notes: Links against bembeyaz-ffi, which scripts/build_rust.py builds and adds to the link.
